# Vendored source

Third-party source kept for attribution and for diffing against, **not compiled into the
application**. This directory is outside `src/`, so nothing here is imported, bundled, type-checked
as app code, or shipped.

## `halide-topo-hero.tsx`

The `halide-topo-hero` demo component from [21st.dev](https://21st.dev), by
**@shivendra9795kumar**. Kept verbatim so that
`src/components/landing/AetosHero.tsx` — which is derived from it — is readable as a diff against
the original rather than as a rewrite that merely resembles one.

It is the source of every mechanism the landing page's quality rests on, all of which are
preserved rather than reimplemented:

- real CSS `perspective` with `transform-style: preserve-3d`, not a 2D skew approximating depth
- pointer-reactive tilt of the whole canvas, with per-layer `translateZ`
- SVG `feTurbulence` film grain over the viewport
- a topographic contour plane floating above the layer stack
- a staged entrance that rotates the canvas up from flat
- `mix-blend-mode: difference` on the hero title, which is what keeps type that large legible
  over moving imagery
- the CTA's angled `clip-path` polygon, reused as the launch wipe's starting shape

### Two notes recorded at install time

- Its three background layers point at `images.unsplash.com`. The reskin replaces them with
  authored SVGs (`public/landing/`) — a console for a defence site should not fetch imagery from
  a third party, and it has to render with no outbound network at all.
- It declares `font-family: 'Syncopate'`, which is not loaded, so it falls back to the generic
  sans-serif.

### Do not edit this file

Edit `src/components/landing/AetosHero.tsx`. The value of this copy is that it is unmodified.
